# OpenStack Cinder CSI Driver Operator {#persistent-storage-csi-cinder}

You can provision and manage OpenStack Cinder storage in OpenShift Container Platform using the OpenStack Cinder Container Storage Interface (CSI) Driver Operator and driver, which provide dynamic volume provisioning.

- [CSI automatic migration](/openshift-docs-markdown/storage/container_storage_interface/persistent-storage-csi-migration#persistent-storage-csi-migration)
